name: smarts.bio
description:
smarts.bio brings a real bioinformatics platform into Claude. 
Describe your analysis in plain English and run actual tools and pipelines on your own data — no scripting or setup required.

What you can do:
* Run sequence searches and analyses — BLAST, GC content, ORFs, domains, and more across DNA, RNA, and protein
* Call and annotate variants, align reads (WES, RNA-seq), and run quality-control and other multi-step pipelines
* Upload and manage workspace files, then open results - FASTA, BAM, VCF, PDB, CSV - in interactive viewers
Search genes, literature, and patents alongside your analysis

Who it's for: biologists, bioinformaticians, computational biologists, and researchers who'd rather describe an analysis than wire up the tooling.

Connect your smarts.bio account to get started. 
Long-running jobs keep working in the background, and your files stay in your own workspace.

_published_faq.name: How do I add smarts.bio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add smarts.bio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.smarts.bio/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the smarts.bio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: smarts.bio provides these MCP tools: smarts_list_files, smarts_list_pipelines, smarts_list_tools, smarts_list_workspaces, smarts_open_file, smarts_query, smarts_read_file, smarts_run_pipeline, smarts_run_status, smarts_run_tool, and smarts_view_as_image.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to smarts.bio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to smarts.bio in health-life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include Groupon, SNOMED CT Terminology, Rhizome AI - FDA & HA Regulatory Research, Aiva, and Amass Connector.
smarts.bio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
smarts.bio is developed by smarts.bio. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
